description: The take-off ledge cut back by 2 tiles, down to the bottom of the level: 15 tiles -> 17
note: Spec: columns 12-13, rows 9-13 (gap 14 -> 16) on the June layout. Here the ledge is 3 rows deep and the pit has no floor, so the 2 columns go from the surface to the bottom. A full run-up from the alcove's back wall still clears 17 tiles; a jump from the start no longer does.
